dead_ends.approach: Gate shell commands with an allowlist of WRITE verbs (MUTATION_TOKEN).
dead_ends.why_failed: Unbounded set: shutil.copy, os.open, curl -o, node -e and find -exec all passed. Inverted to a READ-ONLY verb allowlist.

dead_ends.approach: Fix the specific bypass payloads each verifier reports.
dead_ends.why_failed: Each round found a new spelling of the same class. Recurrence means the mechanism is wrong, not the coverage.

dead_ends.approach: Protect gold records with a `docs/releases/gold/*` glob.
dead_ends.why_failed: `dir/*` matched only children, so `rm -rf <gold dir>` deleted every record while each file was 'protected'.

dead_ends.approach: Put env/time on the read-only verb list.
dead_ends.why_failed: They EXECUTE their arguments: `env rm -rf <dir>` inherited env's read-only verdict. Step through wrappers.

dead_ends.approach: Wire the PreToolUse hook as `python tools/doctrine_guard.py`.
dead_ends.why_failed: From a subdirectory python exits 2 - the hook contract's BLOCK code - so the gate froze its own repair.

dead_ends.approach: Assert `returncode == 0` to prove a hook is wired correctly.
dead_ends.why_failed: That is the one condition a silently-off hook also satisfies. Assert the hook produced output instead.

dead_ends.approach: Refuse blanket guard policies with a list of literal patterns.
dead_ends.why_failed: `?*`, `*.*` and `[a-z.]*` are equally total off-switches. Test patterns against canary paths.

dead_ends.approach: Read the hook payload with sys.stdin.read().
dead_ends.why_failed: It decodes with the interpreter's codec OUTSIDE any try; one bad byte under a strict locale exited 1 with no decision.

learned.claim: An author's self-review approved a control with a two-tool-call bypass; three independent passes vetoed it. Verifier roles must be dispatched, never worn.
Static analysis of a Turing-complete shell cannot be complete, so the Bash path rule is a tripwire; the durable guarantee is doctrine_gold gate, which re-hashes evidence.
A gate must fail closed on the action it judges and never on its own plumbing - a relative hook path froze the session that built it.
False denials fell from 11 of 13 ordinary commands to 0 of 28 after tokenizing commands and resolving paths against the repo root.
